question: These numbered clips are shuffled segments from one cooking video. Determine their chronological order. Return only clip numbers joined by ->.

observed_information.statement: v4 reports rinsing dry grains, adding water to a pot, straining steaming liquid, and returning the strained contents to the pot.
v3 reports parsley, onion, and tomatoes being chopped or sliced into a glass bowl, followed by handling a whole lemon.
v1 reports a lemon being rolled, cut, squeezed into a cup, poured into a bowl of chopped ingredients, and a bottle and spoon being held.
v2 reports dressing being poured into a salad bowl, a close-up of a quinoa-containing salad, and seasonings being added.
v5 reports cooked grains being spooned into a glass bowl of greens and tomatoes, the salad being tossed, and the finished salad being presented.
v1-b0001-e6 and v2-b0001-e1 are reported at source time 895.995 and both show the woman holding a bottle and spoon.
v2-b0001-e3 reports a finished salad containing quinoa at source time 927.994, while v5-b0001-e1 reports cooked grains being added to greens and tomatoes at source time 1014.013.
v3-b0002-e3 reports a whole lemon being held at source time 859.992, and v1-b0001-e1 reports a lemon being placed on a cutting board at source time 864.997.

working_relations.statement: v3 and v1 share a chopped-ingredient bowl state, with v3 showing ingredients being assembled and v1 showing lemon juice being poured into chopped ingredients.
v1 and v2 share a bottle-and-spoon handling state at the reported 895.995 boundary.
v4 and v5 share a grain-preparation state, with v4 showing grains cooked and strained and v5 showing cooked grains transferred to the salad.
v3 and v5 share a glass bowl containing greens and tomatoes, with v3 showing those ingredients being added and v5 showing grains being added to them.
v2 and v5 both report salad presentation stages, but v2 describes a quinoa-containing salad before seasoning while v5 describes grain addition before tossing and presentation.
v3 and v1 share a whole-lemon handling state near the reported 859.992 to 864.997 boundary.
